newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies sink 3.0-cent on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies sink 3.0-cent on long liquidation.

text.p: Continued long liquidation after early selling in an overbought market pushed CME pork bellies down the daily 3.00-cent-a-lb limit, traders said.
Some traders said they were concerned that the recent gain in cash belly prices would turn off demand.
USDA in its closing cut-out value report on Wednesday quoted 12 to 14 lb bellies up $5.00 at $87.00 per cwt.
At 1037 July pork bellies were 3.00 cents a lb lower at 87.250 cents and August was also down the 3.00-cent limit at 86.800 cents.
